text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I wear to go out today? The new piece sent from home is nice, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, my usual jacket really is the best!
It's comfortable, and if I do say so myself, the design turned out great—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way...!?
The sleeve is coming unraveled!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Where did I snag it?
I thought I was handling it so carefully...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...No, there's no point in brooding over it.
First, I need to take it to the tailor.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
So I have to be apart from this little one for a while, huh...?"
